capabilities: record voice notes via mic, ribbon icon, hotkeys, or push-to-talk
transcribe recordings offline with Whisper or GigaAM models
transcribe existing audio files in the vault via right-click
insert transcripts into the focused field, a new note, or the clipboard
apply replacements, voice punctuation, and per-device model settings
extras: Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Models and the ONNX Runtime engine are downloaded once from Hugging Face and GitHub Releases; transcripts and audio never leave the device. A companion Windows app is optional and only reuses an already-downloaded model.
motivation: The README emphasizes no cloud, no API keys, no subscriptions, and privacy — everything runs offline after a one-time model download.
problem: Recording voice notes is easy, but turning them into text usually means cloud services, API keys, or copy-pasting from external transcription tools.

relations.evidence: If Voice Scribe for Windows is installed and has already downloaded GigaAM, the plugin uses that copy

summary: Voice recorder that transcribes on-device with Whisper, inserting text into notes or any focused field, fully offline.
